en: A sepia-toned card mounts a black‑and‑white photographic view of a bust statue on a pedestal in an urban setting. The bust shows a woman in profile wearing historical dress. On the pedestal is an inscription with her name. Behind the statue are the facade and windows of an old building, possibly part of a castle or historic house. Around the central photo is a wide plain beige border with some pencil notations and a red archival stamp near the bottom right.
